feature_schema.name: compute_features_v2
feature_schema.description: Morgan fingerprint (2048 bits, radius=2) + 9 normalized RDKit descriptors (LogP, TPSA, MW, HAcceptors, HDonors, RotBonds, RingCount, FractionCSP3, MolMR) + 17-element pH-7.4 ionization block (strong-acid/strong-base group counts with aryl amines counted separately from aliphatic amines, net-charge class one-hot, formal charge). The first 2057 elements are bit-identical to compute_features_v1. See src/sisyphus/descriptors.py::compute_features_v2.
